_note: Brand corrections for the 6 records whose stored brand (brand + en.brandText + zh.brandText) is a first-word clip of the product TITLE, not a brand. Applying the 2026-11-26 audit: scraping reports derive `Brand` as `Title.split(' ')[0]` (verified 162/162 entries), so any brand that is a plain English/quantity word is a title artefact, not a company name. Each entry below is justified by an independent source on the same record - the Amazon URL slug (brand is the leading token), the listing's Item_Details Brand/Brand Name/Manufacturer, or a brand mention in the record's own features/pros. No entry is justified by the product name alone, because the name is what the bad rule read.

corrections.evidence: Amazon URL slug 'amazon.com/Campior-Green-Wheel-Scooter-Steer/dp/B0DZG3QYLR' + Item_Details.Brand Name='Campior' + Item_Details.Manufacturer='Campior'
corrections.note: Title begins 'Green Mini 3 Wheel Scooter' - 'Green' is a colour/quantity word, flagged by the same rule as the clipped brands. The listing itself says Campior three ways.

corrections.evidence: Item_Details.Brand='Costzon' + Category_Attributes.Brand='Costzon'. Externally confirmed: Amazon lists the SAME product title ('Baby Joy Lightweight Stroller, Compact Toddler Travel Stroller for Airplane ... one-hand fold') on sibling ASIN B0FKN98BJ3 with 品牌/Brand = Costzon.
corrections.note: 'Baby Joy' is the Costzon sub-brand LINE, not the Amazon Brand field. Correcting to 'Baby Joy' would repeat exactly the class of error this ledger exists to fix - reading the title as the brand. Reverted from an earlier draft that used Baby Joy on title-derived evidence.

corrections.evidence: Item_Details.Brand Name='Monamii' + Item_Details.Manufacturer='Monamii' + 'Monamii' appears in the title's model clause and in the record's own features/pros
corrections.note: Title 'Baby Swings for Infants, Monamii Baby Swing' - 'Baby' is a category word.
Same model as stroller-b0d65f9ns7; three sources agree.

corrections.evidence: Item_Details.Brand='WETIFY' + Item_Details.Brand Name='WETIFY' + Category_Attributes.Brand='WETIFY'. Manufacturer='Foshan BeeKoo Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd' is the contract manufacturer, not the brand.
corrections.note: Title begins 'Colorful Lighting Baby Balance Bike...'. 'Colorful' cannot be the brand from the record itself - a DIFFERENT record (balance_bike-b0dg8vrzbz) also stores 'Colorful' but its listing says Doselie. One stored value pointing at two companies is proof it is a title word, not a brand field.
Title begins 'Colorful Glow Wheel Toddler Balance Bike'. Same title-word artefact as balance_bike-b0ccy6yrs8; three fields agree on Doselie.

corrections.evidence: Item_Details.Brand Name="Lil' Rider" + Item_Details.Sub Brand='Motorcycles' (product line, not brand) + Manufacturer='Trademark Global - Toys'
corrections.note: Title begins 'Kids Motorcycle - 3-Wheel Ride on Toy...'. 'Kids' is the product category a shopper searches, not a company. Lil' Rider is the ride-on brand; Trademark Global is the parent/seller.
